from datetime import datetime

def parse_dt(s):
    if not s:
        return None
    try:
        # handle trailing Z
        s2 = s.replace('Z','+00:00')
        return datetime.fromisoformat(s2)
    except Exception:
        return None

# Keep using existing venmo login if present

    venmo_token_resp = apis.venmo.login(username='ta.weav@gmail.com', password=venmo_password)
